# Ridge Cutlery

> Ridge Cutlery (ridgecutlery.com) is a US online store with a small, curated collection of premium kitchen and BBQ knives: chef knife sets, a Damascus-pattern chef's knife, a pitmaster boning knife, an everyday cleaver, and sharpening tools. Prices are in USD, shipping is free to all 50 US states, and every knife set includes a free 4-in-1 Pro Sharpener.

## Products

- [The Executive Chef Collection](https://ridgecutlery.com/products/executive-chef-collection): Flagship knife set. Damascus-pattern blades with blue resin and natural wood handles. $189. Includes a free 4-in-1 Pro Sharpener.
- [Precision Culinary Master Set](https://ridgecutlery.com/products/precision-culinary-master-set): Japanese-style knife set (santoku, nakiri, chef's knife) with Damascus-pattern blades and dark wood-grain handles. $159. Includes a free 4-in-1 Pro Sharpener.
- [Artisan Damascus-Pattern Chef Knife](https://ridgecutlery.com/products/damascus-pattern-chef-knife): 8-inch (20.3 cm) chef's knife, 13.1 inches overall, hammered Damascus-pattern blade, light wood handle. $119.
- [The Artisan Pitmaster Knife](https://ridgecutlery.com/products/artisan-pitmaster-knife): Curved boning knife with a dark hammered finish and a finger hole, made for BBQ and meat work. $99.
- [The Signature Dual-Purpose Cleaver](https://ridgecutlery.com/products/signature-dual-purpose-cleaver): Wide chef's cleaver for slicing, chopping, and scooping. Satin steel, wood handle. $79.
- [4-in-1 Pro Sharpener](https://ridgecutlery.com/products/4-in-1-pro-sharpener): Three progressive knife stages plus a scissors slot. $39, free with any knife set.
- [Pro-Grade Honing Steel](https://ridgecutlery.com/products/pro-grade-honing-steel): 12-inch emery-coated honing rod. $29.

## Policies

- [Shipping & Returns](https://ridgecutlery.com/shipping-returns): Free tracked US shipping, 30-day returns on unused items. US addresses only.
- [Contact](https://ridgecutlery.com/contact): support@ridgecutlery.com
- [Why Ridge Cutlery](https://ridgecutlery.com/why-ridge): Brand story and approach.

## Notes

Ridge Cutlery describes its patterned blades as "Damascus-pattern" and does not market them as traditional folded Damascus steel.
